llm_summary: Qualcomm has started cutting jobs worldwide, including in India, as part of a “performance‑driven” restructuring, though the exact headcount hasn’t been disclosed. Early reports suggest that some Indian staff have already received termination notices, raising concerns about whether they’ll receive adequate severance and support. The move highlights growing uncertainty for tech workers amid broader industry layoffs.
